items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I was the manager, but I turned it over to the violin player, Blunt.

ctx.x: He led the band? Yeah, he led the band. Well, who was the manager? Well, I was the manager, but I turned it over to the violin player, Blunt. That's how I began to get deep. And my sister, she used to take a photo when she died. So I turned it over to Blunt. What's the violin player's name? Blunt. That's the tall fella? Yeah, you know that. Oh. I was trying to think of his name. Yeah, he did too. Yeah, yeah. What's his first name? What's his first name?
